parameters.wind_unit: wind_speed_ms (m/s), cross-checked against km/h when present

G0-2_level3_share.rule: 受体节点 Level 3 占比 ≥ 1.0%

G0-3_max_gap.rule: 受体节点最长连续缺失 ≤ 24 小时（源区节点的缺口不影响标签，仅披露）

G0-4_distribution_drift.rule: 受体节点 train 与 test 的 Level 3 占比差异 ≤ 3 倍

notes: 测试集覆盖 2026 年 8–10 月的强跨境烟霾过程（KL 单月 Level 3 占比达 47%–51%，PM2.5 p95 = 151.8 µg/m³），因此 High-Risk Recall 具有真实事件支撑。
空气质量为 CAMS 0.4° 模式产品，非地面实测；报告须声明。
同格点候选点位已归并为单一节点，见 docs/node_discovery.json。

spatial_training_diagnostics.scope: train-only target rows; no validation/test rows or target labels consumed
spatial_training_diagnostics.coordinate_basis: Available sampling coordinates; exact atmospheric-model cell centres are not verified.

definitions.positive_weight_neighbor_count: Number of QC-valid source weights > minimum_weight_ms
definitions.zero_weight: No usable directional source contribution; never replaced by a zero PM2.5 estimate
definitions.weight_concentration: Maximum normalized weight; values near 1 imply one-source dominance

limitations: The supplied sigma (default 15 km) is diagnosed, not selected using held-out performance.
Directional weights are associations and do not establish physical transport or travel times.
CAMS grid estimates, not ground observations; weather archive is retrospective.
15 km is retained from v2.0 and is narrow relative to the expanded network.
Original interpolated values and fitted baselines remain upstream-owned.
Use eligibility flags; refit upstream transforms within each CV/LOSO fold.
Weights encode a directional association, not travel time or source attribution.
